scope: FABLE set 1 Exercise 11-2, nine existing ordinal cards
userDirection: Only well-established major world-history facts that help explain the broad historical narrative. Replace Korean-history examples. Show all proposed English examples and translations in chat before applying.

cards.ex: Germany signed the World War I armistice on November {{BLANK}}, 1918.
cards.tr: 독일은 1918년 11월 11일에 제1차 세계대전 휴전 협정에 서명했어.
cards.note: Armistice, not a peace treaty; the agreement ended Western Front fighting.

cards.ex: Columbus reached the Americas on October {{BLANK}}, 1492.
cards.note: Arrival at Guanahani in the Bahamas. Do not call this the first arrival or a discovery of an uninhabited continent.

cards.ex: The Mongol Empire expanded across much of Eurasia in the {{BLANK}} century.
cards.tr: 몽골 제국은 13세기에 유라시아의 넓은 지역으로 세력을 확대했어.
cards.note: Century use replaces the earlier Berlin Wall date. Update the old August-date explanation when approved.

cards.ex: A crowd stormed the Bastille on July {{BLANK}}, 1789.
cards.note: Major French Revolution event; keep the existing sentence.

cards.ex: Japan announced its surrender on August {{BLANK}}, 1945.
cards.note: Announcement on August 15; formal surrender signing on September 2. Replaces the Korea-liberation example.

cards.ex: The Scientific Revolution transformed European thought in the {{BLANK}} century.
cards.note: Does not claim that the Scientific Revolution began in the seventeenth century. Replaces the Korean constitution example.

cards.ex: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain in the {{BLANK}} century.
European powers colonized much of Africa in the late {{BLANK}} century.
cards.tr: 유럽 열강은 19세기 후반 아프리카의 넓은 지역을 식민지로 삼았어.
cards.note: Much, not all, of Africa. Replaces April Revolution example; remove the now-unrelated April Revolution explanation when approved.

cards.ex: The two world wars took place in the {{BLANK}} century.
cards.explanationProposal: twenty의 y가 ie로 바뀐다. 제1차 세계대전은 1914~1918년, 제2차는 1939~1945년.
cards.note: Replaces the lunar landing example and its UTC/Korean date explanation.
